items.title: Physical properties of alkenes (printed as a second 11.6.2)

source_refs.note: Physical properties of alkenes (printed as a second 11.6.2) with Quick Check 11.4, page 256.

items: First three members i.e. ethene, propene and butene are gases at room temperature while C₅ to C₁₅ are liquids and the higher members are solids.
They are insoluble in water but soluble in alcohol.
They have characteristic smell and burn with luminous flame.
Unlike alkanes, they show weakly polar properties because of sp² hybridization
